title: I think one of the hardest parts of trading is knowing when you’ve actually improved
author: collosal01
selftext:
Something I’ve been thinking about recently.  
When you’re learning a new skill, improvement is usually obvious. You run faster, lift more, solve problems quicker.  
Trading doesn’t seem to work like that.  
You can make great decisions and still lose money. You can make poor decisions and still have a green week.  
It makes it surprisingly difficult to know whether you’re genuinely becoming a better trader or just having a better run of results.  
The more I trade, the more I think those two things are very different.
